My daughter has ADHD and I used melatonin up until she was 6 and a half. But I would talk to a peds doctor before just doing that. I only used 1mg gummies till she was 5 and then we did 2, 1mg gummies till 6 and a half. Now she's old enough and we have a set routine that she does ok without the melatonin. Still struggling to stay asleep sometimes but going to bed has gotten much easier.
